notes: «قالا حدثنا ح» names no further transmitter for the first branch; the names after the second branch's head («أخبرنا الوليد، عن أبي عمرو، عن عمرو بن شعيب») are written once and form the shared tail.
The Prophet is the end of the chain, not a link.
«وهذا لفظ محمود» is a wording note and is left out.
